mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.article_id, c.user_id, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, c.content, c.created_at FROM article_comment c JOIN user_account u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.article_id = #{articleId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL AND c.status = 1 AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM article_comment c WHERE c.article_id = #{articleId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL AND c.status = 1 AND c.is_deleted = 0

SELECT c.id, c.article_id, c.parent_id, c.user_id, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, c.reply_to_user_id, reply_user.nickname AS reply_to_nickname, c.content, c.created_at FROM article_comment c JOIN user_account u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN user_account reply_user ON reply_user.id = c.reply_to_user_id WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} AND c.status = 1 AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM article_comment c WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} AND c.status = 1 AND c.is_deleted = 0
